description: This file defines a PushRegistrationManager actor in Swift responsible for managing push notification registration with both direct and relay transport modes. It includes data structures for payloads, handling relay registration logic, encoding payloads, and interacting with external relay clients and storage.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing the identity of a relay gateway with device ID and public key.

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing push notification registration, supporting both direct and relay modes with various helper functions.

methods.name: makeGatewayRegistrationPayload
methods.description: Creates a registration payload string for push notifications, handling direct or relay transport modes asynchronously.

methods.name: makeRelayPayload
methods.description: Generates a relay registration payload, involving registration state checks and communication with relay client.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines whether a relay handle has expired based on expiry timestamp.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 hash of a string and returns its hex representation.

methods.name: normalizeTokenSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes a token suffix string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes a generic Encodable payload to a JSON string.
